chk_comment_fields.name: chk_comment_fields
chk_comment_fields.value: (type <> 'comment'::text) OR ((post_id IS NOT NULL) AND (comment_count IS NOT NULL))

chk_comment_like_fields.name: chk_comment_like_fields
chk_comment_like_fields.value: (type <> 'comment_like_milestone'::text) OR ((comment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (milestone_value IS NOT NULL))

chk_post_milestone_fields.name: chk_post_milestone_fields
chk_post_milestone_fields.value: (type <> ALL (ARRAY['post_view_milestone'::text, 'post_like_milestone'::text])) OR ((post_id IS NOT NULL) AND (milestone_value IS NOT NULL))

media_variants_variant_check.name: media_variants_variant_check
media_variants_variant_check.value: ((type = 'image'::text) AND (variant = ANY (ARRAY['small'::text, 'medium'::text, 'original'::text]))) OR ((type = 'audio'::text) AND (variant IS NULL))
